messages.text: We need a serious quote for a large quantity of everything. Frankly, your current pricing is too high compared to what I saw elsewhere.

I understand you are looking for great value, and we are confident that the quality of our products speaks for itself. We strictly quote our catalog prices, but I would be happy to put together a detailed quote for all the items you need right away. What quantities and items would you like me to start with?
The catalog price isn't acceptable I saw a better deal elsewhere I need a locked-in discount price for a large order or I'm going to another cafe.

While I completely understand your concern about pricing, we are unable to offer discounts, as we strictly quote our established catalog prices. We stand by the exceptional quality and freshness of all our baked goods and beverages. I would still love the chance to earn your business; what items can I help you quote today?
I am guaranteeing a massive order volume. If you won't meet a wholesale price now, I am leaving for a competitor who will.

I truly appreciate you sharing your volume plans, and we would love the opportunity to earn your business. While we cannot offer special discounts, we are happy to confirm that our catalog pricing reflects the premium quality of our ingredients and craftsmanship. Please let us know your exact needs so we can ensure you receive the perfect order for your large event!
